name: The Path of the Incarnate
objectives: Earn the trust of the Ashlander tribes
description: The main quest of 3E 427: the Nerevarine's road from outlander to incarnate god-killer, ending the Dreamer beneath Red Mountain.

name: The Corpse and the Skooma Pipe
prerequisites: Speak with Sharn gra-Muzgob in Balmora
objectives: Return the pipe to its owner
description: A quiet mystery in Balmora's back alleys: dead smugglers, a stolen pipe, and a lesson about assumptions.

name: Pilgrimages of the Seven Graces
objectives: Pray at each of the Seven Shrines
Receive the blessing of the Graces
description: The great devotional circuit of the Temple, walking the footsteps of the saints across Vvardenfell.

name: Fargoth's Ring
description: The first errand of the Nerevarine: recover a sentimental ring for the nervous wood elf of Seyda Neen.
